scope: Recursive paired AST comparison permits replacing only an assignment RHS literal zero with a positive-length repeat of literal zero. Assignment destinations, casts, calls, ordering and all surrounding AST remain identical. Byte counts are recorded; old scalar syntax alone does not prove storage width. This does not prove whole-program native equivalence or arbitrary pointer validity.
limitations: Whole-program native equivalence and full runtime type correctness are not established by structural comparison.
New byte-array element counts are recorded; old scalar syntax alone cannot prove the destination storage width.
The unchanged STORE address must designate valid writable storage; arbitrary pointers are not covered.
Nonzero/nonconstant values, other element types and scalar STORE-width mismatches are outside this change.
Raw inherited parser failures retain diagnostics; identifier-only normalization is review-only.
Registered native proof is x86_64 with Rust overflow-checks=off and C-fwrapv. No multiarchitecture native parity claim.
